english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for soldiers or the armed forces as a whole.
Use this for a military force when the surrounding context makes its ground role clear, rather than naming the branch precisely.
Use 軍隊 when service means the armed forces or the military as an institution.

examples.english: The army of the two countries fought at the border.
examples.traditional: 兩國嘅軍隊喺邊境交戰。

examples.traditional: 佢哥哥而家仲喺軍隊入面。
